_comment: Edit this file to change the profile; scripts/generate_stats.py reads it daily.

repos.2imat: a committed virtualenv inflates its byte count; remove once the repo is cleaned
repos.cececat: index.html embeds ~2 MB of base64 font/images that GitHub counts as HTML; remove once assets are split out

featured.title: pitwall
featured.tagline: Pit-stop timing as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process, solved by backward induction, with tyre wear from Gaussian Process regression and Bayesian safety-car estimates.
featured.highlight: Faster in 53% of 57 real 2023 strategies (modelled time)

featured.title: beat-the-dealer
featured.tagline: Blackjack basic strategy derived by simulation, checked cell by cell against an exact solver, plus a Hi-Lo counting study over a billion rounds.

featured.title: monte-carlo-option-pricer
featured.tagline: European, Asian and barrier options under Black-Scholes and Heston, with Greeks by pathwise, likelihood-ratio, finite-difference and closed-form methods.
featured.highlight: 182 unit tests · parallel Python and C engines

featured.title: scm-heston-filter
featured.tagline: A particle filter that tracks the hidden variance of the Heston model from noisy price observations alone: the estimation side of the pricer's problem.
featured.highlight: Bootstrap filter · convergence study by particle count

featured.title: cececat
featured.tagline: A debate tournament manager in a single HTML file: guided setup, pairings, judges that actually rotate, live scoring from each judge's phone and standings.
featured.highlight: No backend · Académico and BP formats

featured.title: salchi-helper
featured.tagline: A tiny dachshund that floats above every window typing at its laptop. The sticker counts your pending tasks; hover and the whole list opens.
featured.highlight: macOS · Windows · Linux · Notion + Google Calendar
